mapper.select: SELECT g.TAX_YEAR AS STAT_YEAR, g.GROUP_LABEL, g.PEOPLE_COUNT, g.AVG_SALARY, g.AVG_DECIDED_TAX, g.AVG_REFUND_TAX FROM GROUP_STAT g JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE g.GROUP_TYPE = 'GENDER_AGE' AND g.TAX_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(TAX_YEAR) FROM GROUP_STAT WHERE TAX_YEAR <= #{taxYear}) AND g.GENDER = m.GENDER AND (g.AGE_MIN IS NULL OR g.AGE_MIN <= #{taxYear} - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.BIRTH_DATE)) AND (g.AGE_MAX IS NULL OR #{taxYear} - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.BIRTH_DATE) <= g.AGE_MAX)

SELECT g.TAX_YEAR AS STAT_YEAR, g.GROUP_LABEL, g.PEOPLE_COUNT, g.AVG_SALARY, g.AVG_DECIDED_TAX, g.AVG_REFUND_TAX FROM GROUP_STAT g JOIN INCOME i ON i.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND i.TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} WHERE g.GROUP_TYPE = 'SALARY' AND g.TAX_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(TAX_YEAR) FROM GROUP_STAT WHERE TAX_YEAR <= #{taxYear}) AND g.SALARY_MIN < i.TOTAL_SALARY AND (g.SALARY_MAX IS NULL OR i.TOTAL_SALARY <= g.SALARY_MAX)
